Guard the flame, guard the seals. …Well, apprentice, what have you come to learn today?
Archivist Isabel
The Chronicle doesn't lie. It's just that… someone tore pages out of it.
Expedition Captain Loran
Maps are drawn with your feet. Are your boots laced tight?
Prologue: The Pier After the Storm (1/3)
The Pier After the Storm

You came in on the ship that broke through the storm, right? Welcome, Storm Survey Corps! I'm Morris, your guide. The Order of the Embers called you here from across the sea. We're short on hands, you see. First, let me show you how to live in Goldia. Please follow 'The Beginner Adventurer's Path' to the end.
Finish all of Morris's 'Beginner Adventurer's Path'.
Well done! You're a Goldian now. The bank, the shops, the land — they're all yours. Oh, and the Order was looking for surveyors.
Finish the Beginner Adventurer's Path
Prologue
The Storm Survey Corps reaches Goldia
Prologue: The Pier After the Storm (2/3)
A Surveyor's Stake

So you're one of the surveyors off this ship. I'm Loran, expedition captain. The Corps doesn't run on swords alone. The smith forges blades, the cook makes soup, the fisher reads the sea. Go see Albert, the job guide, and choose your path.
Go and talk to Albert, the job guide.
Good. The ones who pull their weight stay in the Corps. How many from this ship will stay… we'll see.
Albert the Job Guide
Prologue: The Pier After the Storm (3/3)
The Apprentice's Oath

A new face in the Storm Survey Corps. I am Erwin, elder of the Order of the Embers. To work for the Order you must take the apprentice's oath. Fetch the oath from Archivist Isabel, then recite it before me. "Guard the flame, guard the seals."
Fetch the oath from Archivist Isabel.
"Guard the flame, guard the seals." …Good. Take this ember as well. Every surveyor receives one. Get some sleep early tonight. On the first night, everyone… dreams the same dream.
Archivist Isabel: You're one of the surveyors from this ship, right? Here's the oath.
Archivist Isabel: The oath has three lines. One, guard the flame. Two, guard the seals. Three… the third line has been erased.
Archivist Isabel: My mother copied this oath by hand. She was an archivist too. Fifteen years ago… oh, never mind. Take it to the Elder.
The Burning Knight in the Dream

You who hold the embers. How many are you?
…So many. Even so — not yet. Do not come.
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (1/29)
The Torn Chronicle

Surveyor, I have a favor to ask. This is the Order's Ashen Chronicle. It tells how, a thousand years ago, seven kings divided the world's fire and sealed it away. But look. These pages didn't fall out from age — they were cut out with a blade. Fifteen years ago my mother Elena, the archivist before me, went out to find them and never came back. Her last note says: 'The first page, beside a ruined portal.'
Find a ruined portal. (A Survey Compass will point the way.)

Scorched paper… it's the first page! "The seven imprisoned the fire, and the fire imprisoned one man." And there's an ink dot in the corner. That's the mark my mother left wherever she found something. She made it this far.
Ruined Portal
Chapter One
The Ember Oath
Archivist Isabel, to read it to the end
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (2/29)
An Ink Dot in the Dirt
I read my mother's note again. 'Ruins on the old road, left a mark on a pot shard.' Trail ruins. If you brush away the dirt, old pottery shards turn up. One of them should carry her ink dot.
Find trail ruins, dig up pottery sherds with a brush and bring them back. (A brush is made from a feather, copper and a stick.)
…This is the one. There's a date beside the ink dot. Spring, fifteen years ago. And a name: 'Dowin, miner.' My mother wasn't alone. She had a guide.
Trail Ruins
Pottery Sherds
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (3/29)
Lantern in the Collapsed Shaft

Dowin the miner? I know that name. Went into an abandoned mine fifteen years ago and never came out. The collapsed tunnels crawl with cave spiders. They're poisonous, so bring milk. If you find so much as his lantern, the archivist will be glad.
Find an abandoned mineshaft and kill 6 cave spiders.

Words carved into a sleeper at the end of the tunnel? 'Miss Elena went on to the desert. I stay here. Spiders blocked the way.' …Dowin was a guide to the last. He sent Elena on ahead and stayed behind alone.
Abandoned Mineshaft
Cave Spider
A guide isn't the one who goes first. It's the one who stays last.
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (4/29)
The Second Page in the Sand
Dowin sent Elena to the desert. Must mean the Chronicle's second page lies beneath a desert pyramid. Below it, it's pressure-plate traps everywhere. Watch your step.
Find a desert pyramid.

"The King of the Desert received the Eye in the sand, and the King of Frost the Eye in the ice." …Two of the Seven Eyes. But something's off. Someone opened the chests before us. There were footprints in the sand. Ahead of us.
Desert Pyramid
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (5/29)
Footprints Ahead
The footprints went north, along with crossbow bolts. Pillagers. Why would they collect scraps of paper? Because someone pays them to. Find their outpost and take down the patrol.
Find a pillager outpost and defeat 8 pillagers.
A pouch from the captain's pack. There's gold inside… but I've never seen coins like these. They're not from any kingdom. They're grey. Show them at the town hall. Those people can smell money.
Pillager Outpost
Pillager
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (6/29)
The Grey Coin
Surveyor, may I see that coin? The town hall keeps a sample of every currency that has ever passed through Goldia.
Show the grey coin to Haru, the town clerk.

Nothing in the samples matches. And one more thing. An anonymous bounty was once posted on the town hall board. 'Pages of the Ashen Chronicle, ten grey coins apiece.' Whoever posted it isn't on record. The same bounty went up fifteen years ago, in the spring.
Haru the Town Clerk
Haru the Town Clerk: A grey coin… let me open the sample drawer.
Haru the Town Clerk: Royal gold, pirate gold, even piglin gold nuggets… nothing. Coins like this aren't on record.
Haru the Town Clerk: Look at the image on the back. A man wrapped in a cloak. A grey cloak.
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (7/29)
The Mapmaker Beneath the Igloo

My mother had one more companion. Felix the mapmaker. They spent a winter in an igloo in the snowlands. But under the igloo floor there's a cellar… and rumor says a zombie villager is locked down there. If that's Felix… they say a potion of weakness and a golden apple can bring him back.
Find an igloo and cure a zombie villager.
The villager you brought back said, voice shaking: "Miss Elena… went to the swamp witch for ink. Invisible ink." It was Felix. Fifteen years in that cellar… I'm glad. I'm truly glad.
Igloo
Cure a zombie villager
Felix the Mapmaker
Miss Elena said: 'If I don't come back, tell my daughter to read to the end.'
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (8/29)
The Witch's Ink

Invisible ink. Some pages of my mother's journal were blank. She wrote them with that ink. The witch in the swamp hut knows how to make it. You can't reason with a witch… so defeat her and find the ink jar. And we'll need glow ink sacs to make more.
Find a swamp hut, defeat the witch, and bring 4 glow ink sacs.

There's a recipe written on the ink jar. 'Revealed only under blaze light.' …My mother wrote her journal that way on purpose. So no one could read it in secret. But there's violet ink dried at the bottom of the jar. It's not the witch's ink. All it says is that it's the ink 'the people in the mirror' use.
